title: Blocks to handle: legend, summary, figure, template and a table of buttons
blurb: Fieldsets stacked as folders with their legends as tabs, a <details> element unrolled by a lever, figures fanned out as prints with their alt text, one <template> cloned into tickets that move between layouts, and a minefield that is a table of buttons.
question: Can a 2D canvas turn block elements into things to pick up, pull and press (stacked fieldsets, a details worked by a lever, turned figures, clones of a template, a table of buttons) while every tap still goes to the element?
result: Yes in Chromium 157. The element drawn last takes the input where two overlap, so drawing order is the stacking order. A turned figure is tapped at its turned place. Twelve template clones each had their own hit region, and 36 of 36 buttons in a drawn table were found. A closed details is only as tall as its summary, so the lever opens it and the canvas clips the draw.
